capture.raw_content_publication: private evidence storage; public sanitized hashes/aggregates only
capture.source_url_admission: Use pinned public retrieval URL validator; reject userinfo, private/local/numeric-private destinations before dispatch. HTTPS-only capture follows the prior source-use capture contract; unsupported URLs remain recorded unavailable, never rewritten or replaced. Hostname DNS aliases additionally depend on candidate scraper SSRF controls.

input_provenance.source: Exact same thirteen EXP-078 input artifacts used by EXP-082; retain EXP-082 terminal evidence separately and do not rewrite it.

purpose: Input-preserving operational recovery after EXP-082 stopped at capture: correct the frozen capture wrapper keyword collision only. Keep EXP-082 terminal and inconclusive; reuse the same thirteen frozen pools, candidate, prompts, and numerical gates.

recovery_runtime.health_request: One read-only health validation before capture; failure is terminal with no retry.
recovery_runtime.private_binding: Root-owned private salted configuration receipt binds the exact per-process runtime config. Never place URL, key, user profile, or raw config values in public protocol, source, logs, or receipts.
recovery_runtime.purpose: Operational transport-wrapper correction only: remove duplicate method/url keyword forwarding while preserving the frozen EXP-078 request/response handling, candidate, prompts, and numerical gates.

stop: Any source/input/config integrity failure, health failure, unregistered request, budget/deadline breach, missing required endpoint, or incomplete grade stops the new stage with retained partial evidence; no retries, searches, rescue, tuning, replacement or automatic confirmation.

task_use.assessor_disagreements: separate endpoints, never average into a pass
task_use.completion: all declared critical checks supported, applicable and correctly applied to delivered evidence; model self-certification is insufficient
task_use.source_unavailability: recorded in denominators; not-acquired is an observed state, not automatically a structural packet error
task_use.uncertainty_report: Paired task bootstrap of completion-count difference, 10000 draws, seed7701; descriptive only, no additional significance gate.
